string-array.item: Type a message on the next screen. The third screen registers CustomMessageReceiver and then broadcasts your text to it.
The next screen listens to the system ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED broadcast and shows the live battery level.

resources.string: Enter plain text. It is passed to the next screen in an Intent extra, and that screen sends it to its registered CustomMessageReceiver as a broadcast.
Please enter a message to broadcast
While this screen is visible it registers a receiver for Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED and updates whenever the system reports a change.
Activity 2 passed your text to this screen in an Intent extra. This screen registered CustomMessageReceiver first and only then sent the broadcast, so the receiver cannot miss it.
You chose the system battery notification receiver. Its broadcast was already received on the previous screen, so this screen registers no custom receiver and does nothing else.

AB IT Multimedia does not collect, store or share any personal data. It has no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking, and the only permission it uses is internet access.
The message you type for the custom broadcast is only passed between the app\'s own screens, and the battery level is only read to show it on screen. Neither ever leaves your device.

The only time the app connects to the internet is when Image Scale downloads a photo from picsum.photos over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection. Like any website, that server receives your device\'s IP address with the request. The app sends it nothing else.
The video and the music are stored inside the app. A copy of the downloaded photo is kept in the app\'s cache on your device and is deleted when you clear the app\'s storage or uninstall it.
Questions about privacy: contact AB IT through the developer email address on the app\'s Google Play page.
